review_mode: single read-only A-P pass; final artifacts and strict blind inputs only

read_inputs: current helper source and safe local tests
strict ingestion-recheck case prompts/assertions and named original fixtures
independence.trigger_method: Independent same-model predictions from final frontmatter only; controller may score against withheld labels after report freeze. These are not measured activations.
independence.behavior_method: Independent assertion judgments from only case prompt/files, final instructions and assertion text. Quantitative native compile predicates were also exercised in scratch; remaining behavior is explicitly predicted.

limits: This is a bounded review, not whole-library factual verification, verified acceptance, installation verification, or live skill activation.
No external factual claim, live URL, MCP availability, provider behavior, current service state, global wrapper, registry, semantic index, concept tree or installed source identity was verified.

Passes I/N/O cover static boundaries among the 11 artifacts and available catalog only. Their complete live-registry/concept-tree portions are unavailable; zero local findings does not clear those portions.

Native concept outputs were not promoted into a complete current-format final artifact. Current /ldo finalization, single/family migration, source truth, semantic retrieval and independent agent questions remain separate gates; file:// source Highs may still limit final acceptance.

Large helpers concept_abstract.py and _ldo_v3.py were reviewed in targeted operative spans and exercised by fixtures/tests, not exhaustively proved. Numerical/performance/history/estate/vendor claims inside factual reference material were read as artifact statements and were not independently researched.
Original eval files were existence-checked only. The 33 supplied strict cases, all 110 assertions and 220 unlabeled queries are the evaluation coverage for this report.

No accuracy thresholds can be computed while trigger labels are withheld. A no-trigger prediction for note-organizer query make sense of this mess is low confidence because the query lacks a domain anchor.
